# AgentReady

> The missing layer between your website and AI agents.

## Documentation

- [Quickstart](https://agentready.dev/docs/quickstart): 5-minute setup guide to scoring and optimizing your site.
- [Scoring Rules](https://agentready.dev/docs/scoring): Detailed methodology on how agent-readiness is calculated.
- [CLI Reference](https://agentready.dev/docs/cli): Command-line options for running CI/CD checks and generating llms.txt.

## Optional

- [Full API Spec](https://agentready.dev/docs/api): Complete endpoints reference for developers.
